newsitem.title: CHINA: Santa Fe Energy in China oil search deal.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Energy in China oil search deal.

text.p: The China National Offshore Oil Corp signed contracts with Santa Fe Energy Resources Inc of the United States on Thursday to explore for oil in two offshore blocks in the South China Sea, Xinhua news agency said.

One block is at the mouth of the Pearl River, about 130 km south of Hong Kong and covers an area of 3,200 sq km, Xinhua said, quoting officials of the China National Offshore Oil Corp (CNOOC). Exploratory wells drilled in the area have shown good oil and gas prospects, it said.
The second block in Beibu Bay of the South China Sea covers an area of 2,180 sq km, it said.
Under the contracts, Santa Fe will work alone within the exploration period and bear the costs of offshore operations such as collection of seismic data and drilling exploratory wells, it said.
To date, CNOOC has signed 128 offshore oil contracts with 65 oil companies from 18 countries and regions, Xinhua said. China signed 17 offshore exploration contracts last year, it said.
